reply_text: I replied to Hollis in his #central-team thread that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. Pree first posted Dock 23 on the 14th, then corrected it to Gate 47 the same morning because she'd read the wrong line. Both of her messages were in #central-team, where Hollis asked, so he could already see them.
